game.title: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings

lede: Green Bay Packers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#3 in EPA per play), while Minnesota Vikings owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#1 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Minnesota Vikings -0.8 with a fair total of 40.9 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Green Bay Packers pass offence vs Minnesota Vikings pass defence, which sits −0.124 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
